source.snippet: I wish there was a tool that allowed me to follow Congress as if it was an index. Automatically buying and selling what they buy and sell. Right from my Fidelity or something.

problem_statement: Retail investors want to automatically mirror congressional stock trades in their own brokerage accounts, but no tool integrates congressional trade disclosures with direct brokerage execution.
target_segment: Retail investors and self-directed traders in the US who actively manage their own brokerage accounts
notes: Single HN comment but captures a recurring desire seen across Reddit and fintech communities. Competing products like Quiver Quantitative and Capitol Trades exist for data, but none offer direct brokerage execution hooks. Buyer intent implied — person wants it inside their Fidelity account, suggesting existing brokerage relationship and active trading.
